name: bubble-board

frames.best_why: Shows the whole board with a clear spread of bubble sizes and no cursor over it.

tagline: Pannable honeycomb of bubbles that swell near centre and shrink at edges.
summary: A rounded board filled with overlapping circular tiles in a hex grid. Dragging pans the field, and each bubble scales up as it nears the middle and down toward the frame.
appearance: A dark rounded square with a soft inset shadow holds dozens of grey circles packed in an offset honeycomb. Bubbles vary in size, the largest near the middle and tiny ones clipping at the edges.
behaviour: Dragging anywhere on the board pans the whole field against the frame. Each circle grows as it moves toward the centre and shrinks away at the border, so the grid seems to bulge.
demo_content: Instruction line: Drag the board: bubbles swell toward the centre and shrink at the edges.
search_phrases: pan a field of soft circles
circles that grow near the middle
use_when: A playful media or app launcher needs a tactile, pannable field instead of a plain grid.
avoid_when: Bubbles are empty shapes with no labels or icons, so it stays decorative until wired up.
customise: Bubble count, colours and board size are constants in the file; there are no props, so changing the palette or grid means editing the source.
weight_why: 120 bubble nodes each recompute position and scale on every drag frame.

a11y.note: Pans only by dragging with a pointer; there is no keyboard control, labelling or reduced-motion path.

polish_why: Tactile panned honeycomb with a convincing centre swell; empty bubbles and a plain caption.
title: Bubble Board
